spice-tour.title: Spice Tour
spice-tour.description: A guided plantation walk through cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg, pepper, herbs and medicinal plants — followed by a spice-infused Swahili lunch.
spice-tour.intro: A guided tour through Zanzibar's famous spice plantations — cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg, pepper, vanilla, cardamom, lemongrass, and dozens of medicinal plants. Crush the leaves, taste the fruit, and learn how spices have shaped cooking, medicine, and cosmetics on the island for a thousand years. Followed by a spice-infused Swahili lunch.

items: A Swahili lunch on the farm
Cash for spices to take home

timeline: Air-conditioned van from your hotel. Drive inland through the spice belt.
Met by the farm guide with fresh tropical fruit and a cup of ginger tea.
Through clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, pepper and vanilla. Crush the leaves, scrape the bark, taste the fruit.
Medicinal and cosmetic uses — turmeric, lemongrass, cardamom. The kids usually love this part.
Coconut rice, spice-grilled fish or chicken, fresh salads, fruit. Cooked on-site.
Pick up cloves, vanilla pods or saffron to take home. Cash only.

stone-town.title: Historical City Tour
stone-town.description: A cultural walk through historic Stone Town — the House of Wonders, Palace Museum, Arab Fort, cathedrals, mosques, markets and the carved doors that line every alley.
stone-town.intro: A slow morning through the alleys of Zanzibar's old city — past the House of Wonders, the Palace Museum, the Arab Fort, the cathedrals and mosques, the spice market, and the carved Indian doors that line every street. Led by a guide who grew up here.
highlights: Carved doors, markets, mosques and cathedrals

items: A camera, but ask before photographing people

timeline: Driver brings you to the edge of Stone Town. From here, on foot.
Start at the seafront — the Arab Fort and the old harbour wall.
Exterior of the House of Wonders (still under restoration), then the Palace Museum.
A quiet pause at the Anglican cathedral built over the old slave market.
Sights, smells, fish and fruit. The working heart of Stone Town.
Through the alleys — Arab and Indian doors, Freddie Mercury's birthplace.
Back at your hotel or stay on for lunch in town.

prison-island.title: Prison Island Boat Trip
prison-island.alt: Aldabra giant tortoise on Prison Island
prison-island.description: A boat ride to Changuu — giant Aldabra tortoises, white-sand beaches, coral-reef snorkeling and the historical prison and quarantine station.
prison-island.intro: A 30-minute boat ride to Changuu — the island built (then never used) as a prison, now home to a colony of Aldabra tortoises gifted from the Seychelles in 1919. Some are over 180 years old. A short walk through the prison ruins, a snorkel in the coral pools, and time on a quiet beach.

items: Optional café lunch on the island
Cash for park fee if not pre-paid

timeline: Drive to the Forodhani jetty in Stone Town.
Walk among the Aldabra giants. The oldest are 180+ years.
A short loop through the quarantine station and prison cells.
Coral pools off the small beach — calm and shallow.

jozani.title: Jozani Forest Tour
jozani.alt: Red colobus monkey in Jozani Forest
jozani.description: A guided walk through Zanzibar's only national park — home to the endemic red colobus monkey, chameleons, bush pigs and a raised mangrove boardwalk.
jozani.intro: Zanzibar's only national park and the last refuge of the endemic red colobus — a primate found nowhere else on earth. A guided walk through mahogany and ebony groves, then a raised boardwalk over the tidal mangroves. Quiet, shaded, and surprisingly close-up.
highlights: Chameleons, bush pigs and forest birds

items: Closed shoes — paths can be muddy
Quiet voices, the troops are wild

timeline: Drive south through the spice belt towards Jozani.
Meet your forest guide. Insect repellent on, voices low.
Through the mahogany groves to the habituated troop. Often within a few metres.
Raised loop over the tidal forest. Crabs, mudskippers, kingfishers.
Through the spice belt towards your hotel.

dolphins.title: Dolphin Tour
dolphins.description: A boat trip out of Kizimkazi to spot — and possibly swim alongside — bottlenose and humpback dolphins, run on dolphin-friendly principles.
dolphins.intro: A 5am pickup, a quiet boat out of Kizimkazi to where the bottlenose and humpback pods feed before the sun is up. We follow at distance — engines off — and slip into the water beside them when conditions allow. Always ethical, never chased. Done by 10am and back at your hotel by lunch.

items: Coral & reef fish on the second stop
Mask/fins included; bring own if you prefer

timeline: Early drive south to Kizimkazi. Coffee in a thermos for the road.
Push off as the sun comes up. Engines off when we sight the pod.
Slip in beside them when conditions are right — never chased, never crowded. They'll come if they want to.
Anchor over the coral on the way back. Reef fish, the occasional turtle.
Boat returns to the Kizimkazi harbour.
Grilled fish at a beachfront café. Add-on, not included.

sunset-rock.title: Sunset Trip & The Rock Restaurant
sunset-rock.alt: Sunset on the east coast of Zanzibar
sunset-rock.description: An evening on Michamvi Beach for the sunset, with optional dinner or sightseeing at Zanzibar's iconic Rock Restaurant perched in the tide.
sunset-rock.intro: An evening run across to Michamvi Beach — the only stretch of east-coast Zanzibar that faces west, and so the only place on the island to watch the sun drop into the sea. Time to walk, swim, or settle in for sundowners. Optional sightseeing or dinner at the Rock Restaurant, perched on a coral outcrop in the lagoon.
highlights: Optional visit to The Rock Restaurant

items: Optional walk to The Rock Restaurant
Quiet drive back along the coast

timeline: Driver collects you for the run across to the west-facing peninsula.
Walk on the beach. Quiet at this hour — most resorts face the other way.
Settle in with a drink at a beachfront bar or on the sand.
The only place on Zanzibar where the sun drops straight into the sea.
Walk over (or wade, depending on tide) for photos or dinner. Booking separate.
Quiet return along the coast road.

snorkeling-tour.title: Snorkeling Tour · Blue Lagoon
snorkeling-tour.description: A snorkeling trip to Zanzibar's Blue Lagoon — calm, crystal-clear water, colourful coral reefs, tropical fish and a traditional dhow sail.
snorkeling-tour.intro: A morning on the Blue Lagoon — a sheltered bay of crystal-clear water and shallow coral. We sail out on a traditional dhow, drop anchor over the reef, and snorkel among parrotfish, butterflyfish, and the occasional turtle. Calm water, gentle currents, suitable for first-time snorkelers.
snorkeling-tour.priceNote: Per person depending on group size

items: Calm sailing on a traditional dhow
Mask/fins included; bring own if you prefer

timeline: Short drive to the dhow launch point.
Life jackets fitted, masks and fins handed out. Sails up.
Calm shallow water. Parrotfish, butterflyfish, sea urchins, starfish.
Fresh fruit on deck while we sail across the lagoon.
Slightly deeper coral. Look for turtles in the seagrass.
Lazy return leg with the breeze on the beam.

village-tour.title: Village Tour · Bwejuu
village-tour.description: A guided walk through Bwejuu village — meet locals, visit homes, shops, and schools, and experience authentic east-coast Zanzibari life.
village-tour.intro: A slow walk through Bwejuu — a fishing and seaweed-farming village on Zanzibar's east coast. You'll meet locals, look in on a school and a few small shops, see how seaweed is dried and sold, and share tea with a family if the timing works. Run with — and giving back to — the village.
highlights: Meet locals in their homes & shops
See seaweed farming and fishing up close

items: Daily life on the east coast
A small gift if visiting a home

timeline: Meet your local guide — born and raised here.
Past family homes and small dukas (shops). Stop where invited.
Meet the teachers. Photos OK with permission.
See how Bwejuu's main industry works — mostly run by women's cooperatives.
If the timing works — chai, coconut bread, conversation.

mnemba.title: Mnemba Snorkeling & Trip to the North
mnemba.alt: Aerial view of the island and sandspit inside the turquoise Mnemba reef ring
mnemba.description: A full-day combining snorkeling around the Mnemba coral ring with relaxation on Nungwi Beach in northern Zanzibar.
mnemba.intro: A full day combining the two best stretches of north-coast Zanzibar — a morning snorkel on the Mnemba coral ring (easily the island's clearest water and best reef), then transfer to Nungwi for lunch, beach time, and a slow drive back south.

items: Underwater camera if you have one
Mask/fins included; bring own if you prefer

timeline: Drive up to Matemwe on the north-east coast.
20 minutes across to the coral ring.
On the reef wall — Zanzibar's best visibility, often 20m+.
Drift line along the south side. Bottlenose dolphins frequent at this hour.
Boat or road transfer up to the north tip.
Long, slow lunch on the sand at a local spot.
Swim, walk the sand, watch the dhow yard at work.

safari-blue.title: Safari Blue
safari-blue.alt: Traditional dhow sailing in Menai Bay
safari-blue.description: A full-day dhow sailing adventure in Menai Bay — sandbank picnics, mangrove swims, snorkel reefs and seafood lunch.
safari-blue.intro: A full day aboard a traditional sailing dhow — out from Fumba into the Menai Bay conservation area. Mangrove channels, a snorkel stop on Kwale's reef, lunch grilled on the sandbank, a swim in the natural lagoon, and the slow tack home as the sun drops.

items: Sail traditional dhow out of Fumba

timeline: Air-conditioned van from your hotel. Coffee or tea in a thermos.
Brief safety chat from the captain, life jackets fitted, sails up. The first hour is pure sailing.
Drop anchor in a hidden lagoon. The water is glassy and warm. Float, don't swim.
Masks, fins, and roughly 45 minutes in the water. Parrotfish, butterflyfish, the occasional reef shark.
Catch of the day on the grill. Coconut rice, fresh salads, fruit. We sit on mats in the shade.
The wind shifts onshore. Most people sleep on deck. We don't rush.
Quick rinse, van back to the hotel. Home by 5, sun-tired and salt-crusted.

fishing-kizimkazi.title: Fishing in Kizimkazi
fishing-kizimkazi.description: A deep-sea fishing day off the Kizimkazi shelf — tuna, kingfish, marlin and dolphin fish in rich pelagic waters.
fishing-kizimkazi.intro: A deep-sea fishing day off Kizimkazi, where the continental shelf drops fast and the big-game pelagics run. Targets include yellowfin tuna, kingfish, marlin, sailfish and dorado (dolphin fish) in season. Trolling and jigging gear provided. Catches we keep are split with the boat crew or grilled on the beach.

items: Sun protection — full day on water

timeline: Early drive south to the Kizimkazi launch.
Out past the reef and over the shelf where the deep water starts.
Lines set for tuna, kingfish and dorado. Coffee on deck.
When the rod bends, you take the chair. Crew handles the rest.
Sandwich, fruit, soft drinks. Lines stay out.
Final hour — often the best, with the tide turning.
Catch sorted on the dock — what you keep, what's split with the crew.

local-fishing.title: Local Game Fishing
local-fishing.description: A traditional fishing morning with Zanzibari fishermen aboard a wooden dhow — simple gear, hand-lines, and a real day at sea.
local-fishing.intro: A morning at sea with a small crew of Zanzibari fishermen — out on a wooden dhow, working the inshore reefs with hand-lines and simple traditional gear. Targets are the everyday fish that feed the island: tuna, barracuda, grouper, snapper and queenfish. A real working trip, not a charter — slower, quieter, and far closer to how the coast has fished for centuries.
highlights: Sail with local fishermen on a wooden dhow
timeline: Short drive to the dhow launch.
Wooden boat, lateen sail, no engine. Out with the morning breeze.
Hand-line down. The crew shows you how — simple but effective.
Boil water on a small stove. Sweet chai with the crew.
Move along the reef to where the queenfish are running.
With the morning breeze on the beam.

mangrove.title: Mangrove Tour · Chwaka Bay
mangrove.alt: Mangrove channels and shallow turquoise water seen from above, Zanzibar
mangrove.description: A boat tour of the Chwaka Bay mangroves — snorkeling, seabird habitats, mangrove channels and a local lunch on the bay.
mangrove.intro: A morning out on the Chwaka Bay mangroves — the largest mangrove forest in Zanzibar and one of the richest seabird habitats on the East African coast. We move through the channels by local fishing boat, stop for a snorkel where the bay opens, and break for a Swahili lunch at a small village kitchen.
highlights: Swahili lunch in a fishing village
timeline: Drive across to Chwaka Bay on the east coast.
Wooden fishing boat — the kind locals use to set traps in these channels.
Slow paddle through tidal forest. Look for crabs, mudskippers, the occasional monitor lizard.
Herons, kingfishers, fish-eagles. Bring binoculars if you have them.
Calm, shallow water — different reef life from the open sea.
Swahili spread cooked at a small village kitchen.

sandbank-picnic.title: Sandbank Picnic · Pange
sandbank-picnic.description: A relaxed full-day combining Prison Island with leisure, snorkeling and a long lunch on the Pange Sandbank.
sandbank-picnic.intro: A relaxed full day combining a Prison Island morning — Aldabra tortoises, a short walk, the prison ruins — with an afternoon on the Pange Sandbank, a strip of white sand that surfaces at low tide a few kilometres off Stone Town. Snorkel from the boat, swim, sunbathe, and lunch served on the sand.

items: Cash for park fees if not pre-paid

timeline: Walk among the giants and through the old prison.
Mats, parasols and shade laid out for you.
Grilled seafood, salads, fresh fruit on the sand.
Free time in shallow, clear water.

cave.title: Swimming in Maalum Cave
cave.description: A half-day visit to the Maalum natural cave — a freshwater cave pool open to the sky, one of Zanzibar's most scenic swims.
cave.intro: A half-day to Maalum Cave — a natural sinkhole in the coral rag, ringed with hanging roots and open to the sky. The pool inside is freshwater, cool, and chest-deep. A short ladder descent, a long quiet swim, and time to sit in the shade above. A perfect break from the salt and heat of the coast.
highlights: Cool, calm swim out of the sun
One of Zanzibar's most photogenic spots

items: Short walk to the cave entrance
Long, calm swim in fresh water
Time to sit and photograph above
Water shoes if you have them

timeline: Drive south through the spice belt.
Brief intro and entry fee at the gate.
A short wooden ladder down into the open sinkhole.
Cool freshwater, chest-deep. The roots hang down from above.
Coffee or fresh juice at the small café on the rim.

north-nungwi.title: Trip to the North · Nungwi
north-nungwi.alt: Aerial view of the Nungwi beach strip, north Zanzibar
north-nungwi.description: A north-coast sightseeing day around Nungwi — Zanzibar's best beaches, dhow-builders, the turtle aquarium and a long, slow lunch on the sand.
north-nungwi.intro: A day on the north coast — Nungwi has Zanzibar's widest beaches, the best swimming at any tide, and a working harbour where dhows are still built by hand. We stop in at the dhow yard, visit the natural turtle aquarium at Mnarani, and break for a long lunch on the sand. Loose, easy, no rush.
highlights: Best swimming beaches on the island

items: Long lunch and afternoon on the beach
Cash for lunch and the aquarium
A book — there will be downtime

timeline: Drive up the west coast towards Nungwi.
Visit the natural tidal pool. Feeding times if you time it right.
Watch boats being built by hand using century-old techniques.
Long, slow lunch at a beachfront spot.
Best swimming beaches on the island — Nungwi's deep water at any tide.

cooking-coffee.title: Cooking Class & Coffee Experience
cooking-coffee.description: A market visit, a spice-farm walk, a hands-on Swahili cooking class and a Zanzibar coffee ceremony on a Stone Town rooftop.
highlights: Cook a Swahili meal from scratch

street-food.title: Street Food & Night Market Tour
street-food.description: An evening through Forodhani Night Market and Darajani — Zanzibar pizza, urojo soup, mishkaki, fresh seafood and sugar-cane juice.

healer-herbal.title: Traditional Healer & Herbal Medicine
healer-herbal.description: Meet a traditional Swahili healer and learn about local medicinal plants, herbal remedies and the spiritual practices used for generations.

village-workshop.title: Village Immersion & Workshop
village-workshop.description: A deeper village experience — coconut weaving, cooking, farming, pottery and traditional crafts, with lunch shared at a local family home.

private-sunset-dhow-dinner.title: Private Sunset Dhow Cruise with Dinner
private-sunset-dhow-dinner.alt: Private dhow at sunset with dinner setup
private-sunset-dhow-dinner.description: A private luxury dhow at sunset — seafood dinner, Swahili music, tropical drinks and candlelight under the stars.

nakupenda.title: Nakupenda Sandbank Picnic
nakupenda.description: A relaxed half-day on the famous Nakupenda Sandbank — snorkeling, seafood lunch, tropical fruits, sunbathing and crystal-clear water.

mangrove-kayak.title: Mangrove Kayak Adventure
mangrove-kayak.description: A guided kayak through mangrove forests and hidden waterways — peaceful nature, birdlife, local villages and (optionally) sunset views.

chumbe.title: Chumbe Island Coral Park
chumbe.description: A day on the protected Chumbe Marine Park — snorkel one of East Africa's healthiest reefs, walk the nature trail, and learn about the conservation work.
chumbe.priceNote: Marine park day trip per person

seaweed-coop.title: Seaweed Farming & Women's Cooperative
seaweed-coop.alt: Women working the seaweed farms at low tide, Zanzibar east coast
seaweed-coop.description: A morning on the seaweed farms with the women who run them — see harvesting, drying and how the seaweed is turned into soaps and skincare.

turtle-conservation.title: Turtle Conservation Tour
turtle-conservation.description: A visit to a Zanzibar turtle rescue and rehabilitation centre — learn about the work, feed the turtles, optionally swim in the natural lagoon.

butterfly-center.title: Butterfly Center & Nature Walk
butterfly-center.description: A guided tour of the tropical butterfly gardens near Jozani — conservation work, identification walks and the wider biodiversity of the forest.

stargazing.title: Stargazing Beach Experience
stargazing.description: A peaceful nighttime beach session — telescope viewing, African sky legends, a small bonfire, and (optionally) astrophotography.

organic-spice.title: Organic Spice & Herbal Farm Tour
organic-spice.description: An upgraded spice tour focused on organic farming, medicinal herbs, sustainability and the permaculture practices used on the smaller farms.

turtle-nesting.title: Turtle Nesting Volunteer Experience
turtle-nesting.description: A seasonal conservation activity — beach cleanups, turtle-nest monitoring and environmental education with the local marine teams.

kitesurfing.title: Kitesurfing Lessons & Safaris
kitesurfing.description: Professional kitesurfing in Paje and Jambiani — beginner lessons, advanced clinics and downwind kite safaris with full equipment.

horse-riding.title: Horse Riding on the Beach
horse-riding.description: A scenic beach ride — gentle rides for beginners, sunset and swimming-with-horses options, and private romantic rides on request.

quad-bike.title: Quad Bike Safari Adventure
quad-bike.description: An off-road quad-bike route through villages, plantations and hidden beaches — short cultural stops and tropical fruit tasting along the way.

jet-ski.title: Jet Ski Adventure
jet-ski.description: A high-speed run along the coastline — guided routes to hidden beaches and clear-water bays, or freestyle on the open water.

parasailing.title: Parasailing Experience
parasailing.description: A short, thrilling lift over the ocean — aerial views of the coastline and turquoise water, with tandem and solo options.

skydive.title: Skydive Zanzibar
skydive.description: A tandem skydive over the Zanzibar coastline — open-ocean views, beach landing and full HD video of the jump.

dhow-building.title: Traditional Dhow Building Experience
dhow-building.alt: Dhow being built at Nungwi yard
dhow-building.description: A hands-on cultural experience with local dhow craftsmen — woodworking, traditional boat-building demonstrations, village stories and refreshments.
dhow-building.intro: Step into a working dhow yard with the craftsmen who still build Zanzibar’s wooden boats by hand. Learn the shape of the hull, try simple woodworking, hear the stories behind the trade, and connect the coast’s maritime culture to the boats you still see on the water.
dhow-building.priceNote: Shared experience from $45 · private from $120 · premium workshop from $180

advanced-diving.title: Advanced Diving Excursions
advanced-diving.description: PADI-led dives at advanced sites — Leven Bank and Tumbatu — drift dives, coral gardens, turtles, barracuda, tuna and reef sharks.

transparent-kayak-sup.title: Transparent Kayak & Paddleboarding
transparent-kayak-sup.description: A relaxed paddle in transparent kayaks and stand-up paddleboards — see reef life and small marine animals beneath you while you cruise.

ocean-sand-combo.title: Ocean & Sand Adventure Combo
ocean-sand-combo.description: A premium full-day combining jet ski, parasailing, snorkeling, kayaking and a sunset dhow cruise — every water activity in one go.
highlights: Jet ski + parasail in the morning

historical-ruins.title: Zanzibar Historical Ruins Tour
historical-ruins.description: A heritage circuit — Mtoni Palace, Maruhubi Palace, Kidichi Persian Baths, Mangapwani slave chambers and the lesser-known Sultan sites.

hidden-alleys.title: Stone Town Hidden Alleys Tour
hidden-alleys.alt: Narrow residential alley in Stone Town, Zanzibar
hidden-alleys.description: A deeper Stone Town walk through hidden alleys, secret courtyards, carved doors, art studios and the neighbourhoods most visitors don't see.

persian-baths-sultan.title: Persian Baths & Sultan Heritage
persian-baths-sultan.description: Zanzibar's Persian influence in detail — Kidichi and Hamamni Baths, the palace ruins and the family stories of the Omani Sultanate.

mangapwani-cave.title: Mangapwani Coral Cave & Slave Chambers
mangapwani-cave.description: A drive up the west coast to the Mangapwani coral cave and the underground chambers used during the illegal slave trade after abolition.

dhow-heritage.title: Dhow Heritage & Maritime Tour
dhow-heritage.description: A tour through Zanzibar's maritime heritage — dhow culture, boat-building traditions and the centuries of Indian Ocean trade that shaped the islands.

sauti-busara.title: Sauti za Busara Festival
sauti-busara.alt: Sauti za Busara festival, Stone Town
sauti-busara.description: Zanzibar's biggest African music festival — live concerts inside the Old Fort, carnival parades through Stone Town, food stalls and late nights.
highlights: Live concerts at the Old Fort

ziff.title: Zanzibar International Film Festival
ziff.alt: ZIFF screening at the Old Fort
ziff.description: ZIFF — East Africa's largest film festival, with screenings, art exhibitions, workshops, music performances and Stone Town nightlife.

water-sports-festival.title: Zanzibar Beach & Water Sports Festival
water-sports-festival.description: A seasonal sports and entertainment week — dhow races, kite surfing, kayaking, beach games, local performances and water competitions.

private-vip-island.title: Private VIP Island Day
private-vip-island.description: A fully private day — premium dhow, private chef, snorkeling, beach setup, drinks, photography and a personalised itinerary, end to end.

wellness-yoga.title: Wellness & Yoga Retreat Experience
wellness-yoga.description: A wellness day combining beach yoga, meditation, healthy Swahili cuisine, massage therapy, sound healing and ocean relaxation.

mafia-whale-shark.title: Mafia Island Whale Shark Experience
mafia-whale-shark.description: A seasonal trip from Zanzibar to Mafia Island — swim with whale sharks during their feeding season and explore one of Tanzania's richest marine ecosystems.

forest-spice.title: Forest & spice
forest-spice.desc: Red colobus monkeys in the morning, plantation walk and Swahili lunch in the afternoon. The classic nature-and-culture day, all done before sundown.
rhythm: Track red colobus monkeys and walk the mangrove boardwalk before the day gets hot.
Move inland with time for photos, fruit stands, and a relaxed pace.
Walk the plantation, taste tropical fruit, and finish with a Swahili lunch.

full-stone-town-day.title: A full Stone Town day
full-stone-town-day.desc: Spice plantation in the morning, lunch on the seafront, heritage walk through Stone Town in the afternoon. Home by 5pm with a head full of stories.
rhythm: Start inland with cloves, cinnamon, vanilla, fruit tasting, and a plantation lunch.
Break by the seafront before moving into the old city on foot.
Explore carved doors, markets, the Arab Fort, cathedrals, mosques, and old trading streets.

south-coast-nature.title: South-coast nature
south-coast-nature.desc: Sunrise dolphins out of Kizimkazi, then a short drive to Jozani for the red colobus monkeys. Both done before 2pm. Lunch at a beachfront local spot on the way home.
rhythm: Head out early from Kizimkazi for respectful dolphin viewing while the water is calm.
Walk the forest paths and mangrove boardwalk with a local nature guide.
Finish with a simple beachfront lunch before returning to your hotel.

tortoises-alleys.title: Tortoises & alleys
tortoises-alleys.desc: Heritage walk in the morning while it's still cool, boat to Changuu after lunch for the Aldabra tortoises. The two best half-days, stitched into one.
rhythm: Walk Stone Town before the heat builds: markets, carved doors, old forts, and the seafront.
Pause for a relaxed lunch close to the jetty.
Cross to Changuu for giant tortoises, prison ruins, beach time, and coral pools.

reef-mangrove.title: Reef & mangrove
reef-mangrove.desc: A morning snorkel on the Blue Lagoon reef, then move to Chwaka Bay for the mangrove channels and a Swahili lunch in a fishing village.
rhythm: Start in calm reef water with masks, fins, tropical fish, and a relaxed boat crew.
Move toward Chwaka Bay for a local meal and slower island rhythm.
Explore mangrove channels, seabirds, and the quieter side of coastal Zanzibar.

north-coast-all-day.title: North-coast all-day
north-coast-all-day.desc: Snorkel the Mnemba coral ring at first light, then up to Nungwi for lunch and the afternoon — Zanzibar's clearest water and its widest beaches in a single day.
rhythm: Boat out early for the clearest water and best reef conditions around Mnemba.
Head north for lunch near the beach and time to reset.
Swim, visit the dhow yard or turtle aquarium, and enjoy Zanzibar’s widest beach.

ngorongoro-tarangire.alt: Black rhino on the plains during a Ngorongoro and Tarangire safari
ngorongoro-tarangire.title: Ngorongoro & Tarangire
ngorongoro-tarangire.intro: Descend the crater for the Big Five at first light, then move to Tarangire’s elephant herds and baobabs. A classic Northern Circuit pairing.

days.p: Drive 2hrs to camp. Evening game drive among the baobabs.
Full-day drive along the Tarangire River. Hundreds of elephants in the dry months.
Drive via Lake Manyara (optional stop for tree-climbing lions). Lodge perched on the crater edge.
Pre-dawn descent. Black rhino, lion prides, flamingo flats. Picnic at Ngoitokitok Springs.
Visit Olduvai Gorge (Leakey’s "cradle of mankind"). Fly back to Zanzibar.

ngorongoro-tarangire.includes: ✓ All flights & transfers · ✓ Lodge upgrades · ✓ Crater fees · ✓ Cultural visit included

serengeti-migration.alt: Zebra herd on a Serengeti track during migration season
serengeti-migration.title: Serengeti Migration
serengeti-migration.intro: Track the great wildebeest crossing on the Mara River. Tented camps, dawn game drives, sundowners on the kopjes.

days.p: Bush flight via Arusha. Afternoon game drive in the central Serengeti.
Full-day drive following the migration. Picnic lunch on the plains. Optional balloon at dawn.
Predator territory — lion, cheetah, hyena clans. Fly back to Zanzibar at sunset.

serengeti-migration.includes: ✓ Bush flights · ✓ All meals · ✓ Park fees · ✓ Pro guide

nyerere-selous.alt: Buffalo and egret near wetlands in Nyerere National Park
nyerere-selous.title: Nyerere (Selous) Wild
nyerere-selous.intro: Boat safaris on the Rufiji, walking with armed rangers, fly-camping under the stars. The road less travelled.

days.p: 50-min flight to Mtemere airstrip. Afternoon boat safari at sunset.
Morning bush walk with ranger. Afternoon game drive — wild dog territory.
Move to a fly-camp deeper in the reserve. Camp fire, no fences, full stars.
Final boat safari at dawn (hippos, crocs, fish eagles). Fly back midday.

nyerere-selous.includes: ✓ Boat & walking safaris · ✓ Fly-camping kit · ✓ All gear & meals · ✓ Ranger fees

ruaha-big-cat.alt: Male lion resting in grass on a Ruaha big-cat safari
